Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the function of antibodies, confusing the concept of "engulfing" (phagocytosis) with "binding" (antibody-antigen interaction). Antibodies do not engulf viruses; they bind to them to mark them for destruction by other immune cells (opsonization). The Planner prematurely concluded the task with an incorrect answer (C) based on a fundamental misunderstanding of immunology, failing to verify the biological facts before declaring TASK_COMPLETE.
